note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Trump-Xi summit puts AI safety talks on the table but neither side wants to slow down

items.title: Texas data center backlash shapes 2026 election races

items.title: McDonald's stock falls as it unveils plan to spend big on restaurant upgrades
items.blurb: The chain unveiled ArchIQ, an AI restaurant system that takes orders and schedules shifts, which it says saves about 50 labor hours a week.

items.title: Altman pushes for AI cooperation at UN after Trump rebuffs controls

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on AI doom theories: "Enough predictions"
